crm-tags.heading: Firm tags
crm-tags.heading-copy: Create reusable tags for work across your firm.
crm-tags.catalog-copy: Tags keep the same ID when you rename or recolor them. Retired tags stay available for earlier work.
crm-tags.retired: Tag retired. Earlier work keeps its saved tag ID.
crm-tags.save-failed: Could not save the tag catalog.
crm-tags.references-copy: Renaming, recoloring, or retiring a tag never changes the tag IDs saved by tasks, workflows, events, files, or bulk work.
